notes.title: Update 1.0.9
notes.notes:
- Made the reeds spawn only near water. 
- Small improvements.

notes.title: Update 1.0.8
notes.notes:
Building System Overhaul – We've resolved issues with the building system for a smoother construction experience.

Material Feedback – You’ll now see which materials are returned when dismantling buildings.

Ghost Removal Tool – Use your hammer to destroy leftover or mistakenly placed building ghosts.

Brightness Button Fixed – Adjust your visuals with confidence; the brightness control is now fully functional.

New Workbench Added – Craft with expanded possibilities using the newly introduced workbench.

notes.title: Update 1.0.7
notes.notes:
Carpathian Update: New Features & Enhancements

Tutorial Added: New players can now get familiar with the game’s controls with our tutorial! Learn all the essential keys and mechanics to help you get started on your adventure.

Sawmill: The sawmill is now available! Use it to process wood into planks and other materials to enhance your crafting and building capabilities.

New Cooking Pot: Cook up your recipes with the new cooking pot! It’s perfect for preparing more advanced dishes to boost your survival.

Primitive Forge: We've added the primitive forge, a must-have for crafting tools and weapons from raw materials. Start forging your own gear today!

DLSS 4 Update: We’ve updated from DLSS 3 to DLSS 4, offering improved performance and enhanced visual quality for smoother gameplay.

Water Lily: New water lilies have been added to the world! Use them for crafting or simply enjoy the new scenery as you explore.

notes.title: Update 1.0.6 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Update 1.0.6 Patch Notes:

* Fixed: Removed pickable items under buildings to prevent clutter and improve gameplay experience.

* Updated: Replaced stone weapons with primitive weapons for a more authentic early-game experience.

* Added: New water well and furnace for enhanced crafting and resource gathering.

* Fixed: Changed the back key in the main menu from "X" to "ESC" for better consistency.

* Updated : Renamed the "Option" tab in the game menu to "Menu" for clearer navigation
